About Kymeta
Born from metamaterials innovation
Built upon fundamental metamaterials research at Duke University, Kymeta's disruptive technology is supported by a world-class R&D facility, and a team that includes some of the brightest minds in the industry. Together, we are building and delivering an Intelligent Communications Platform to enable network access and spatial intelligence, anytime and everywhere.

1967
Physicist Victor Veselago, Ph.D., publishes an analysis stating that materials could be created to have both negative permittivity and permeability. This theoretical material does not exist in nature, but Veselago's research shows the remarkable properties such a material would possess.
